item.title: Games end on your last check-in day
item.summary: A game with days off at the end, like Monday to Friday over a week, now ends when your last check-in day closes, so the results and recap come the next morning instead of after the weekend.
item.details: The score can't change once that day's late-post hour passes, so Murph settles the game then. Games that count any days you choose still run their full length.
